name: Etched Note
summary: At Camp Narache, a summons calls a young tauren hunter to train with Lanka Farshot. The message marks the start of study in the ways of the wild.

sections.title: A Summons to the Hunt
sections.body: Grull Hawkwind passes the etched message to a young tauren with a gift for marksmanship and tracking. The novice has been training among the bluffs of Red Cloud Mesa. Lanka Farshot has taken notice of the youth's bloodline and raw ability, and calls them to study under his watch.

sections.title: Tradition of the Plains
sections.body: Among the Shu'halo, hunters do more than scout or fight. They feed the tribes with their quarry, guard nomadic camps, and keep close to the beasts of Kalimdor. Lanka's training begins with weapons and the creatures of Mulgore. In time, the novice may learn the ancient art of taming wild companions.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Note?
aliases: why did i get etched note
faq.answer: The Etched Note introduces a novice tauren hunter to Lanka Farshot, the trainer in Camp Narache.
Grull Hawkwind passes the note along and says a messenger from the hunter trainer sought out the young hunter moments earlier.
Lanka Farshot is in Camp Narache on Red Cloud Mesa, near the hunter training grounds, ready to instruct new hunters.

faq.q: Why are hunters so revered among the tauren?
faq.answer: Hunters feed the tauren, read the wilderness, and keep harmony with the spirits of the plains.

faq.q: What skills does this training introduce?
faq.answer: Lanka teaches basic hunting, ranged weapons, knowledge of wild beasts, and, in time, the rites for taming animal companions.

faq.q: What is the next step after reading the note?
faq.answer: You can report to Lanka Farshot in Camp Narache to begin training. He teaches you to fire your rifle, tame a pet, and more as you grow.

angles.text: As a hunter, you begin learning marksmanship, survival in the wild, and how to live with beast companions.
As Shu'halo, you honor the Earth Mother by respecting the beasts that sustain your tribe across Mulgore's plains.
